a.text: Once upon a time, there was a strange pink Nightmare that roamed the wild west.
Its hide was black charcoal, its hair charred clouds, its horns twisted briar.
Many were deceived by its beautiful mask, mesmerized by its sweet scent, falling into deep dreams, becoming its nourishment.
The Nightmare targeted Lupo children, once luring thousands of children away from a city in a single night.
But the wise Siracusans came up with a way to fight the terrible pink Nightmare—
The Nightmare was afraid of wolves. When you saw it, you'd simply cry 'Wolf!' three times, and the Nightmare would disappear without a trace.

steps.text: That is QUITE enough! I can't listen to any more of this!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: No need to get excited, Dolly. The musician isn't wrong; that's what Siracusan legends say about sheep.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: If you're not happy about it, you could always jump on top of his head from your sheep float. After all, no one would be surprised about anything that happens tonight, no matter how out of this world it is.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Look, I just like getting chased by wolves. Playing hide-and-seek with them was one of the few hobbies I had during my time in Siracusa.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: How could they twist the story like that? Blasphemy, I say, blasphemy!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: That ain't the word I'd pick for it.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Stop throwing cold water on our fun.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: How do the Siracusans see YOU, Emperor?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Tell 'im about the black-robed singer, Big Mouth!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Well... once upon a time, there was a mafia Don who loathed music and banned it in his city, until a penguin singer dressed in a black robe arrived many years later.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: When he started singing at the town square, the citizens, having no concept of music, found it too noisy and tried to catch the singer and hand him over to the Don.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: But the singer was too quick and slippery, even for the most athletic young man.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: He continued to sing as more and more people joined the chase, which eventually turned into a great dance that engulfed the entire city.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: The singer sang for three days and three nights until the furious Don had enough and came to catch him personally. But the Don was caught in the revelry as soon as he walked out of the door, and was never seen again.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Why does Emperor get to sound like a brave, clever hero when he's not half as wise as I am?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: It ain't about wisdom, it's about Graf Pangwen's attitude toward music! Freedom n' struggle! You never did listen to the albums I signed for you, did you?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Let's go, we're getting in the way.

steps.name: Musician
steps.text: (Plays excitedly)

steps.name: Acrobat
steps.text: (Juggles excitedly)

steps.name: Musician
steps.text: (Plays even harder)

steps.name: Acrobat
steps.text: (Shows off skills)

steps.name: Passerby A
steps.text: Achille? Where's my Achille?

steps.name: Passerby B
steps.text: Did you just realize you had been walking with a stranger for half-an-hour, Signora?

steps.name: Passerby A
steps.text: Oh, I recognize your voice! You're that judge from Terni... I'm so sorry, the Leica famiglia made me lie in court—

steps.name: Passerby B
steps.text: (Taps mask) All water under the bridge, Signora. Remember the rules of Carnevale?

steps.name: Passerby B
steps.text: Look around at the sea of smiles around you! Fool and king, queen and priest, all are the same in their masks. Forget the scores of the past, and let us toast to the future of Nuova Volsinii!
The crowd passes by three Aristocrats of Beasts, as Dolly's clones meander through the sea of people. All can see them; no one shows any surprise.
In this ocean of revelry, not a single sea spray feels out of place.
A dozen massive floats form an orderly row, carrying the visages of wolf, sheep, penguin, cat, dog... legendary beasts that have come together in this city to lead the procession.

The streets are brimming—nay, overflowing—with plays and improvised performances. Musicians and acrobats seem locked in a competition to outdo one another, forcing food cart owners to raise their voices even higher to peddle beer, pizza and ice cream.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: This is even more exciting than an active volcano.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Better than the old Carnevale. Even fatso didn't enjoy that kind of party.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Please don't dirty the word 'party' by usin' it on a mafia-masked murder-fest.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: One tree don't bear two fruits. The Siracusans are just like those wolves.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Thousands of years ago, we left the wolves out of our parties because those dumbass pups didn't know nothin' but fighting and killing. So they came up with their own game.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Lucky the Siracusans are smarter, and they decided there's things worth celebrating besides killing and fighting for territory.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: As for the wolves that don't know how to change—

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: They sense the same thing that we do. They know something is not right.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: We're 'kindred', after all. There are certain things that we need to talk about.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I've met the ones that are less stupid, but they won't listen to anyone until their stupid game is done.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Well, they got a sayin' in Yan, and it means basically 'When in Londinium, do as the Londiniers do.'

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Now, if this is a party, the Siracusans better not let me down!
Wind brushes against Demetri's cheeks.

The windows of the ward were closed when he left yesterday, and Lavinia had instructed the nurse to keep a close eye on the temperature in this autumn season. But he sees only an empty bed when he looks up.
It's been a while, Demetri.

steps.name: Private Physician
steps.text: I'm sorry, Signor Bellone, this man insisted on coming in. I tried calling City Hall and the courts to reach Judge Lavinia, but I couldn't get through...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It's okay. You can leave.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: When did you wake up?

The bright lights illuminate the skies and shine upon the hospital ward. The noise of the crowd can be clearly heard even through the window. Leontuzzo stands next to the window, gazing down at a city in revelry.
He has changed out of his patient clothes, and there is no hint that he was in a coma not so long ago.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: A few hours ago.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You know, I thought we were meeting up at a restaurant, not a hospital.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Good, you still remember what you were doing before the accident. Looks like it didn't damage your brain.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Tsk.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You sure didn't lose any time to get dressed as soon as you woke up. Don't tell me you plan on attending the festivities.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Surely the nurses have told you that you need to lie down and get some rest... you're still wrapped in bandages underneath those clothes, aren't you?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Just a little light-headed. Got some pills for it, and I feel much better now.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Hundreds of thousands of citizens will be on the streets tonight, celebrating the one-year anniversary of Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The original plan calls for the parade to start from the expansion plate, travel through twenty-three streets across nine plates, where it will be joined by various festivities.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: At midnight, they will arrive at Court Square, where I will address the crowd and welcome a new day together with them—

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: City Hall has contingency plans.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Your inauguration can surely wait until you're in better shape.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Do you really think that, Demetri?
Leontuzzo turns around.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Lavinia has yet to announce the cancellation of the speech. I don't think it's because she forgot to.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I have a rough idea of what's been going on these few days.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The car accident at the port district, then the fire at Nuova Volsinii port... what will the citizens think if the mayor misses tonight's scheduled event?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: If Carnevale concludes without a hitch, then the worst thing that comes out of my absence is that I lose a few approval points.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But if there is something hidden under the bright lights outside the window, I need to be at the scene.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Let's reschedule our dinner to another day.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Today.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: The Carnevale has begun. The whole city is busy. Didn't you hear the doctor? Neither City Hall nor the courts are answering phone calls.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I'm afraid they have their hands full, right now.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I brought some people with me. We can escort you to the scene.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You don't have a choice, Leon.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: If you know what's been happening the past few days, then you have at least an inkling of what's going on between me and Saluzzo, but you didn't bring it up.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I have some things I have to tell you. Today is the chance.
Leontuzzo gazes at his old friend.
The threat in Demetri's words are thinly-veiled. After a brief moment of silence, Leontuzzo extends his hand.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'll be counting on you, then, Demetri.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Just like old times.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: How are you feeling, Grandma?

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: You're lost, my child.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I am looking for the last true wolf. I have wasted too much time.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Easy, my child. It's not your fault.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: Grandma has taught you how to tell the scent of a true wolf's pelt.

steps.name: Grandma
steps.text: But the last true wolf is clever. He is a weaver of pelts, hiding his scent perfectly. He is a...

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: ...Tailor.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma guides me.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I will find the true wolf. Wait for me, grandma.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: ...de Montano.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Oh, xuj!

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Wh-What is it, Lyudmila?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: ...Red hood.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: That one again? Where?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: The alley up ahead. I could recognize her from a mile away.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Man, we were just taking a minute to change the tires, and you run into her AGAIN?

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: You want to go after her?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Let's get back on the truck. Eirene's waiting for us.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: I left Sommer at the accident scene the last time in order to go after her, which just seemed to lead to all this crazy shit...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You know what's funny? I keep running into bad luck just like I keep running into her. It's like a curse I couldn't shake.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: It's a brutal pack of wolves that we're facing today. I've seen what they're capable of.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: That's why I need to be with you guys, this time.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Well, nothing for you to be ashamed of.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: The bastard taunted you when you tried to take revenge and killed your mentor. You're way calmer than I would be if I was in your shoes.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: You know what, once we get all this crap out of the way tonight, we'll come with you to find her, beat her up, and tie her up behind our trucks so that she gets to know what dust tastes like.

steps.name: Truck Driver
steps.text: Nobody messes with OUR ragazza sfortunata.

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Hah. Well, let's get going.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Dammit, boss, this place was hard to find.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Our guys are in position, but are you sure you don't want to be on scene at a time like this?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Come. Look.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Court Square?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Man, this house is so close to Court Square? I took so many turns on my way here that I thought I ended up in another district. Hell, I could see the posters on the courthouse windows...

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Well-concealed, but offers a perfect view of the square and the surrounding streets.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I will be giving orders in real-time from right here, until the dust settles.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: How'd you get your hand on such prime real estate in such a short time?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: It has been under my name for a long time.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I bought it soon after I came to Nuova Volsinii. I come here from time to time, when I wanted some time off.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...To stare at the courthouse and City Hall?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: How are things with the old man?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: No problems. The estate's crowded, and they got enough whiskey, cigars, and classic records to keep him busy all night.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: The port?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Gambino got everything set up. Our landship is the only thing that's coming to the city tonight... it's almost time, come to think of it.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: All our vehicles are being deployed around the Nuova Volsinii port. The goods'll be delivered to every associate of the famiglia once the landship has docked.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Then, it's up to us.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Where is the parade procession?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The new art district, where all the theaters and entertainment establishments are. There's lots of performances on the streets, and activities for visitors to interact with the floats.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: At least an hour until it gets here.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: We have a small number of select famiglia associates nearby, equipped with the weapons that we had smuggled in.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: The square is undermanned, with most of Nuova Volsinii's police keeping order along the parade route. Suppress the courthouse and other administrative buildings quickly and efficiently.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: With the port and the courthouse in our hands, and the supplies from the landship, Famiglia Venezia will become the de facto rulers of Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: It's time for Nuova Volsinii to wake up from revelry.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I just thought of somethin'.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: City Hall's plan calls for the parade to be welcomed at the square by Leontuzzo's inaugural speech, where he's gonna talk about stuff like the new order and Siracusa's future n' whatever...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You gonna say something too when they're welcomed by fully-armed associates of Famiglia Venezia?

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: There is no need, Capone.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: If you need to think about something, think about whether you still remember how to use a weapon after all the time you spent working at a vehicle company.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: All good—

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: I know your history, Capone. The Sicilians started the first city state war in the history of Siracusa.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: You looted through the city, pointing your weapons at all who would resist or speak up, and harvested the tails of the vanquished with sickles.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: That was Siracusa's first Carnevale, even though the name came later.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: This is your chance to prove that the history of Siracusa began with you, Sicilian.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Well, that sort of talk is better for Gambino. He's the one who could never stop talking about 'Sicilians'.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Lungmen, Volsinii, Nuova Volsinii... we've gone from one place to another over the years. The Sicilians fell on hard times after Signora Sicilia abandoned her familglia.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Which is why I've never forgotten how to pull a trigger.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Good, good.

steps.name: Antonio
steps.text: Do it.

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant A'
steps.text: Happy Carnevale, signore! Have a balloon!

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Thanks... hey, wait a minute.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Is the parade here already? I thought I would hear from the folks at the earlier stops.

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Gugh—

steps.name: Police Officer
steps.text: Y-You're...

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant B'
steps.text: Hm. Slower on the uptake than I thought.

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant A'
steps.text: What did you think was gonna happen? This ain't Signor Mayor's promotional video, where we go to the ground as soon as a cop tags us.

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant A'
steps.text: They've been on the job for, what, one year?

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant A'
steps.text: There is no famiglia in Nuova Volsinii. Did you think they would have the skill or the guts to put their head on the line, when all they do is issue traffic tickets?

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant C'
steps.text: Left side of the square is clear.

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant D'
steps.text: Right side, same here.

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant E'
steps.text: The roads that connect the courthouse and the administrative building is secure. No survivors.

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant F'
steps.text: Caught a few paper pushers as they were coming out.

steps.name: 'Carnevale Participant F'
steps.text: Damn, one got away and went back into the courthouse—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Alright, no complaining.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It's time. Do it!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What time is it, Texas?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Eleven.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Here's your whiskey with ice.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You've been looking at these route maps over and over again, Lavinia. Take a break.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The area around the square has been cleared of all non-relevant personnel. Traffic control is in effect from the new art district to the courthouse. All that's left is to wait for the procession.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What's your decision?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You're not concerned that it would cause a panic if it's the 'Last Texas' who makes the midnight speech, rather than the Acting Mayor as originally planned?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: No, I'm not.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Every float tonight is themed after a legendary beast, however mysterious or cruel, and many citizens have put on masks to play the wolf pack.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Beast or man, they will walk together tonight in Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I can think of nothing more appropriate for the Carnevale than having the Last Texas give a speech to the citizens about a better future.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And I can think of no one else who could take Leontuzzo's place as guest of honor.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Alright, let me see that draft again...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm sorry, Texas, but I need to prepare for all possible contingencies.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You've looked on edge since you came back from the truckers' camp.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I've done what I could in the time that I had, but the threat hasn't been eliminated. Tonight—

steps.name: Panicking Clerk
steps.text: J-Judge Lavinia!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What's the matter... is that blood on your clothes?

steps.name: Panicking Clerk
steps.text: A large group suddenly showed up at the square. They took out the police...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Who were they?

steps.name: Panicking Clerk
steps.text: I couldn't tell... they were all dressed up in costumes and wearing carnival masks.

steps.name: Panicking Clerk
steps.text: But they looked like they're ready to charge into the courthouse!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Get your wounds treated. I'll check it out.

steps.name: Panicking Clerk
steps.text: No, Judge Lavinia! They're all over the square! If you go out now—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If that's the case, hiding here won't do any good.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm with you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Good.
Stay here, Lavinia.
I'll deal with what's going on outside.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Eirene?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: It's all wise guys. They want this building, and the Supreme Justice—you.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I'm here to protect you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Protect me?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: How—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What the—
Lavinia rushes to the window.
The pack of beasts that had lay dormant in the darkness begins their hunt.
Elaborately dressed, masked figures emerge from the alleys and approach the courthouse in orderly formation, quickly making their way through the police lines.
And no further.
A truck appears out of nowhere, coming to a screeching stop in their path. The police barricade that it sent flying makes a dull sound as it hits the ground.
Then, a second, and a third, as truck after truck barge into the square.
Demonstrating surprising coordination, they form a tight line between the oncoming crowd and the courthouse, stopping it in its tracks like a dam stops the tide.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: They won't get near the courthouse for a while.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I feel like I've seen this before...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Perhaps you've seen City Hall's promotional video for Signor Bellone.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Insurgent mafiosi block off the courthouse with trucks, creating an area in the city where the police cannot reach, allowing them to exact wanton violence...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: That was the inspiration. I wouldn't have thought of it if I wasn't part of the shoot.
Eirene closes the window.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Time is short, Lavinia.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: There is much that we need to resolve.
